title: Tertiary lymphoid structure drives allograft rejection via IFN-gamma-JAK-STAT-dependent atypical memory B cell differentiation.
authors: Ma, Lijie; Gong, Shiming; Fang, Jianchen; Feng, Mingxuan; Zhan, Zhenzhen; Xia, Qiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肝移植排斥中三级淋巴结构通过IFN-gamma-JAK-STAT通路驱动非典型记忆B细胞分化，属于免疫病理与临床转录组分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Tertiary lymphoid structure (TLS) is a neogenized, ectopic lymphoid aggregate found in infected, autoimmune and tumour tissues with an activated adaptive immune response. However, a comprehensive understanding of the pathological role, function, and formation of TLS in allograft rejection remains incomplete. METHODS: We enrolled two large retrospective cohorts of liver biopsy (LB) after pediatric living donor liver transplantation (LDLT) and developed a deep learning pathomics (DLP) model. Gene expression profiles and corresponding clinical information of 590 cases were enrolled from three transcriptomic databases, including cohort-GSE193135 (n=337), cohort-GSE145780 (n=235), cohort-Renji (n=18). ESTIMATE, CIBERSORT, XCELL and MCP analyses were performed to visualize the immune landscape. Single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis of 11 LBs after LDLT and multiplexed immunohistochemistry (mIHC) were performed to validate the discoveries of bioinformatics analysis. RESULTS: We provided evidence that increased TLS in the liver was closely correlated with allograft rejection, fibrosis, and declined liver function. ScRNA-seq and in vitro co-culture analysis revealed that TLS form through the differentiation of atypical memory B (AtM B) cells via the JAK-STAT signalling pathway, stimulated by IFN-gamma from exhausted CD8(+) T effector memory (T(EM)) cells. The presence of TLS resulted in IgG accumulation, initiating pathological antibody-dependent cell-mediated phagocytosis (ADCP) of apoptotic hepatocytes by CD68(+) macrophages. Preclinically, blocking JAK1/3 or knocking out Lta in mice limited TLS formation and attenuated allograft rejection in mouse orthotopic liver transplantation models, informing novel therapeutics for allograft rejection pathology. CONCLUSION: We proposed an efficient DLP model for predicting allograft rejection, and revealed an unexpected immunological mechanism of TLS in allograft rejection livers and clarified an IFN-gamma-JAK-STAT-dependent circuit that could be targeted with drugs and transformed AtM B cells into potent instigators of hepatocellular injury in allograft rejection.
abstract_zh: 背景：三级淋巴结构（TLS）是一种新生的异位淋巴聚集体，存在于感染、自身免疫和肿瘤组织中，伴随适应性免疫反应的激活。然而，关于TLS在同种异体移植物排斥中的病理作用、功能及形成机制，目前仍缺乏全面理解。方法：我们纳入了两个大型回顾性队列，涉及儿童活体肝移植（LDLT）后的肝活检（LB），并开发了一种深度学习病理组学（DLP）模型。从三个转录组数据库中纳入了590例基因表达谱及相应临床信息，包括队列GSE193135（n=337）、队列GSE145780（n=235）和队列仁济（n=18）。采用ESTIMATE、CIBERSORT、XCELL和MCP分析来可视化免疫景观。对LDLT后的11例LB进行了单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）分析，并进行了多重免疫组化（mIHC）以验证生物信息学分析的发现。结果：我们提供了证据表明，肝脏中TLS的增加与同种异体移植物排斥、纤维化和肝功能下降密切相关。ScRNA-seq和体外共培养分析揭示，TLS通过非典型记忆B（AtM B）细胞经JAK-STAT信号通路分化形成，该过程由耗竭的CD8(+) T效应记忆（T(EM)）细胞释放的IFN-gamma刺激。TLS的存在导致IgG积累，启动由CD68(+)巨噬细胞对凋亡肝细胞进行的病理依赖性抗体介导的细胞吞噬作用（ADCP）。在临床前研究中，阻断JAK1/3或敲除小鼠中的Lta可限制TLS形成，并减轻小鼠原位肝移植模型中的同种异体移植物排斥，为同种异体移植物排斥病理提供了新的治疗策略。结论：我们提出了一种高效的DLP模型用于预测同种异体移植物排斥，并揭示了TLS在同种异体移植物排斥肝脏中的意外免疫机制，阐明了一个IFN-gamma-JAK-STAT依赖的回路，该回路可通过药物靶向，并将AtM B细胞转化为同种异体移植物排斥中肝细胞损伤的强效诱因。
